RejectionMetadata.description: The artifact and the final version, as the path names them.

artifact.description: must be a lowercase DNS label (a-z, 0-9, -), letter first, letter or digit last, at most 63 characters, as a stage name
artifact.title: Artifact

version.description: must be a final version, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (SemVer 2.0.0 core, no leading zeros), at most 128 characters
version.title: Version

RejectionSpec.description: The digest rejected, under both its rc and its final version, and why.

digest.description: must be sha256: followed by exactly 64 lowercase hex digits
digest.title: Digest

reason.description: must be one line of 1 to 500 characters with no space at either end, and no control, format, line or paragraph separator, or space other than U+0020 (categories Cc, Cf, Zl, Zp, Zs in Unicode 15.0, a fixed table)
reason.title: Reason

RejectionSpec.title: RejectionSpec

description: A rejected version of one artifact, rejections/<artifact>/<version>.yaml, written by GORA only (ADR-026 section 7); metadata names the artifact and the final version of its path. Its content never changes and the file is never removed. An optional field is absent or holds a value, never null, and a mapping or list it holds is never empty. Top-level fields appear in the order apiVersion, kind, metadata, spec, writtenBy.

writtenBy.description: must be a SemVer 2.0.0 version without build metadata: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional -PRERELEASE, no leading zeros, no +BUILD, not ending in .lock (a version is also a git tag and part of a branch name), at most 128 characters
